name: scroll-area
title: Scroll Area 滚动区域
description: 固定尺寸区域内的滚动，各浏览器滚动条样式一致。

whenToUse: 固定高度或宽度的区域内滚动，需要统一的滚动条外观
accessibility: 保留原生滚动和键盘滚动
区域内没有可聚焦元素时，确保键盘用户仍能滚动查看内容
responsive: 必须给出高度或宽度，否则不会滚动

files.content:
# Scroll Area 设计规范

- 用于固定区域内的自定义滚动条（侧栏列表、弹层中的长内容）；整页滚动保持浏览器原生滚动。
- Scroll Area 必须有确定的高度或最大高度（`h-*`、`max-h-*` 档位类，或在 flex 布局中 `flex-1 min-h-0`），否则不会出现滚动。
- 横向滚动设 `orientation="horizontal"`，两个方向都需要时设 `both`。
- 用 `viewportLabel` 给视口命名并提供键盘焦点。视口支持方向键、Page Up、Page Down 和滚轮。
- 设置导航用 `appearance="settings"`。内容溢出时出现浅深自适应的细滑块，轨道透明。滑块支持拖动。
- 滚动条不能改变版面：出现或消失时，内容不能左右晃动。整页滚动条库里已统一处理：位置预留（根元素 `scrollbar-gutter: stable`），轨道透明，只露出细滑块，没有滚动槽；不要在页面或布局上再写 `overflow-y: scroll`、`overflow-y: overlay` 之类的补丁。
- 横向滚动，或内容会动态变长变短的区域，用 Scroll Area（`orientation="horizontal"` 或 `both`）：滚动条浮在内容上方，只显示滑块、不占位，并按内容比例自动伸缩。原生横向滚动条占的是高度，无法预留，所以不要用在内容会变化的地方。
- 固定尺寸的嵌套容器可用 `overscroll="contain"`，在滚动到边缘时让滚动停在本区。内嵌视口的键盘焦点只使用内描边。

<script lang="ts">
	import { ScrollAreaScrollbar, ScrollAreaThumb } from "@ui-sdk/svelte/scroll-area";
	import { createAttachmentKey } from "svelte/attachments";
	import { cn, type WithoutChild } from "$UTILS$.js";
	import type { HTMLAttributes } from "svelte/elements";

	let {
		ref = $bindable(null),
		class: className,
		orientation = "vertical",
		forceMount,
		children,
		...restProps
	}: WithoutChild<HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>> & {
		ref?: HTMLElement | null;
		orientation?: "vertical" | "horizontal";
		forceMount?: boolean;
	} = $props();
	const refProps = {
		[createAttachmentKey()]: (element: HTMLDivElement) => {
			ref = element;
			return () => {
				if (ref === element) ref = null;
			};
		},
	};
</script>

<ScrollAreaScrollbar
	{...refProps}
	data-slot="scroll-area-scrollbar"
	data-orientation={orientation}
	data-vertical={orientation === "vertical" ? "" : undefined}
	data-horizontal={orientation === "horizontal" ? "" : undefined}
	{orientation}
	class={cn(
		"data-horizontal:h-2.5 data-horizontal:flex-col data-horizontal:border-t data-horizontal:border-t-transparent data-vertical:h-full data-vertical:w-2.5 data-vertical:border-l data-vertical:border-l-transparent flex touch-none p-px opacity-0 transition-[color,opacity] select-none data-visible:opacity-100 motion-reduce:transition-none",
		orientation === "vertical" && "h-auto!",
		forceMount && "flex!",
		className
	)}
	{...restProps}
>
	{@render children?.()}
	<ScrollAreaThumb
		data-slot="scroll-area-thumb"
		class={cn(
			"rounded-full relative shrink-0 bg-border",
			orientation === "vertical" ? "w-full" : "h-full"
		)}
	/>
</ScrollAreaScrollbar>

<script lang="ts">
	import {
		ScrollArea as SdkScrollArea,
		ScrollAreaViewport,
		ScrollAreaContent,
		ScrollAreaCorner,
		type ScrollAreaType,
	} from "@ui-sdk/svelte/scroll-area";
	import { createAttachmentKey } from "svelte/attachments";
	import { cn, type WithoutChild } from "$UTILS$.js";
	import Scrollbar from "./scroll-area-scrollbar.svelte";
	import type { HTMLAttributes } from "svelte/elements";

	let {
		ref = $bindable(null),
		viewportRef = $bindable(null),
		class: className,
		appearance = "default",
		orientation = "vertical",
		type,
		scrollHideDelay,
		viewportLabel,
		overscroll = "auto",
		scrollbarXClasses = "",
		scrollbarYClasses = "",
		children,
		...restProps
	}: WithoutChild<HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>> & {
		ref?: HTMLElement | null;
		type?: ScrollAreaType;
		scrollHideDelay?: number;
		appearance?: "default" | "settings";
		orientation?: "vertical" | "horizontal" | "both" | undefined;
		scrollbarXClasses?: string | undefined;
		scrollbarYClasses?: string | undefined;
		viewportRef?: HTMLElement | null;
		viewportLabel?: string;
		overscroll?: "auto" | "contain";
	} = $props();

	const scrollbarAppearance = $derived(
		appearance === "settings" && "data-vertical:border-l-0 data-vertical:px-0.5 data-horizontal:border-t-0 data-horizontal:py-0.5 **:data-[slot=scroll-area-thumb]:bg-[lch(64.94%_1.25_282)] dark:**:data-[slot=scroll-area-thumb]:bg-[lch(37.275%_1.2_272)]"
	);
	const rootRefProps = {
		[createAttachmentKey()]: (element: HTMLDivElement) => {
			ref = element;
			return () => {
				if (ref === element) ref = null;
			};
		},
	};
	const viewportRefProps = {
		[createAttachmentKey()]: (element: HTMLDivElement) => {
			viewportRef = element;
			return () => {
				if (viewportRef === element) viewportRef = null;
			};
		},
	};
</script>

<SdkScrollArea
	{...rootRefProps}
	data-slot="scroll-area"
	data-appearance={appearance}
	type={type ?? (appearance === "settings" ? "auto" : undefined)}
	{scrollHideDelay}
	class={cn("relative min-h-0 min-w-0", className)}
	{...restProps}
>
	<ScrollAreaViewport
		{...viewportRefProps}
		data-slot="scroll-area-viewport"
		role={viewportLabel ? "region" : undefined}
		aria-label={viewportLabel}
		tabindex={viewportLabel ? 0 : undefined}
		class={cn(
			"size-full max-h-[inherit] rounded-[inherit] outline-none focus-visible:outline-1 focus-visible:-outline-offset-1 focus-visible:outline-ring",
			orientation === "vertical" && "overflow-x-hidden!",
			orientation === "horizontal" && "overflow-y-hidden!",
			overscroll === "contain" && "overscroll-contain"
		)}
	>
		<ScrollAreaContent>{@render children?.()}</ScrollAreaContent>
	</ScrollAreaViewport>
	{#if orientation === "vertical" || orientation === "both"}
		<Scrollbar orientation="vertical" class={cn(scrollbarAppearance, scrollbarYClasses)} />
	{/if}
	{#if orientation === "horizontal" || orientation === "both"}
		<Scrollbar orientation="horizontal" class={cn(scrollbarAppearance, scrollbarXClasses)} />
	{/if}
	<ScrollAreaCorner />
</SdkScrollArea>
